title: test_fib fails after update to BRCM SAI 4.2
author: daall
body:

**Description**
test_fib.py was working up until we cut over to SAI 4.2 in brcm master image 436. Now it is failing consistently. We suspect this is due to a regression between 3.7 and 4.2.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run test_fib.py against any brcm master image from version 436 or later.

**Describe the results you received:**
test_basic_fib:
```
"======================================================================", 
E                   "FAIL: fib_test.FibTest", 
E                   "----------------------------------------------------------------------", 
E                   "Traceback (most recent call last):", 
E                   "  File \"ptftests/fib_test.py\", line 351, in runTest", 
E                   "    self.check_ip_ranges()", 
E                   "  File \"ptftests/fib_test.py\", line 154, in check_ip_ranges", 
E                   "    self.check_ip_range(ip_range, next_hop, ipv4)", 
E                   "  File \"ptftests/fib_test.py\", line 169, in check_ip_range", 
E                   "    self.check_ip_route(src_port, ip_range.get_first_ip(), exp_port_list, ipv4)", 
E                   "  File \"ptftests/fib_test.py\", line 191, in check_ip_route", 
E                   "    res = self.check_ipv4_route(src_port, dst_ip_addr, dst_port_list)", 
E                   "  File \"ptftests/fib_test.py\", line 250, in check_ipv4_route", 
E                   "    return verify_packet_any_port(self, masked_exp_pkt, dst_port_list)", 
E                   "  File \"/usr/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/ptf/testutils.py\", line 2533, in verify_packet_any_port", 
E                   "    % (result.port, device_number, ports, result.format()))", 
E                   "AssertionError: Received expected packet on port 1 for device 0, but it should have arrived on one of these ports: [27]."
```

test_hash (ipv4 & ipv6):
```
"======================================================================", 
E                   "FAIL: hash_test.HashTest", 
E                   "----------------------------------------------------------------------", 
E                   "Traceback (most recent call last):", 
E                   "  File \"ptftests/hash_test.py\", line 264, in runTest", 
E                   "    self.check_hash(hash_key)", 
E                   "  File \"ptftests/hash_test.py\", line 87, in check_hash", 
E                   "    self.check_balancing(next_hop.get_next_hop(), hit_count_map)", 
E                   "  File \"ptftests/hash_test.py\", line 252, in check_balancing", 
E                   "    assert result", 
E                   "AssertionError", 
E                   "", 
E                   "----------------------------------------------------------------------", 
E                   "Ran 1 test in 47.199s"
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
All three test cases should pass.

comments.author: gechiang
comments.body: This is a hashing issue. There are a lot of changes made from 3.7.5.3 to 4.2.1.3.  Most of the changes were made to support HX4 platform where the hash field is being programmed differently.  But some of the code seems to be confused as when it needs to program which field.  I made some manual changes and IPV6 started to pass but IPV4 and basic still fails.  I have already opened a CSP CS00011388674 asking BRCM to investigate/fix this issue.

comments.author: lguohan
comments.body: is hashing completely not working in 4.2 or it is not load balanced correctly?

comments.author: gechiang
comments.body: @lguohan It is not load balanced correctly.  We tried manually generating packet with different IP and do see the hash difference.  So hashing is working but the overall load balancing no longer balance distribution correctly and thus causing the test case to fail.

linkedPullRequests.title: Upgrade to SAI BCM 4.2.1.5-6 to pick up the fib hash patch (CS0001138…
linkedPullRequests.author: gechiang
linkedPullRequests.body:
…8674) and the fdb invalid port patch (CS00011298546)

**- Why I did it**
In SAI 4.2.1.5 there are two issues discovered by nightly test:
1. FIB Hashing issue where it does not evenly distribute to all LAG members and thus causing fib test failure.  A patch to address this issue was provided by BRCM (CS00011388674) and validated with a private build.
2. FDB event has invalid port, flooding syslog with error messages.  A patch to address this was also provided by BRCM (CS00011298546) and validated with a private build. 

**- How to verify it**
For the fib hash issue please refer to (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/5681).
For the FDB invalid port issue please refer to (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/5616).

**- Description for the changelog**
Moving BRCM SAI 4.2.1.5 to 4.2.1.5-6 to pick up fix for FIB Hashing issue (CS00011388674) and FDB Invalid Port issue (CS00011298546).

Fixes #5681 
Fixes #5616
